generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch on GM Ultium: 102 kWh gross (about 100 kWh usable) pack, DC up to 190 kW. The pack is unchanged through 2027, including the 2026 Lyriq-V. 2027 is a port change only (CCS1 to NACS), with the same 102 kWh pack, so it is not split. Canada and US use the same powertrains; Wikipedia gives no Canada-specific differences. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadillac_Lyriq ; https://gmauthority.com/blog/2026/04/2027-cadillac-lyriq-getting-nacs-charge-port/amp/
